PRIVACY NOTICE & CONSENT TO PROCESS PERSONAL DATA

Welcome to Swasthya Kids Clinic ("we", "our", or "us"). We operate the website https://swasthyakids.in and our mobile application (collectively, the "Platform") to provide pediatric healthcare services for patients aged 0 to 18 in Delhi, India. 

In compliance with the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 (DPDP Act) and the Digital Personal Data Protection Rules, 2025, this notice explains what personal data we collect, why we collect it, your rights, and how you can exercise them.

1. DATA PRINCIPAL & PARENTAL CONSENT
Because our services are for minors (individuals under 18 years of age), personal data must be provided and consented to by a parent or lawful guardian. By accepting this notice, you confirm that you are the parent or legal guardian of the child for whom you are creating an account, and you lawfully consent to the processing of your child’s personal data as set out below.

2. PERSONAL DATA WE COLLECT
To provide our pediatric services, we collect the following personal data:
- Child's name and date of birth
- Parent's name
- Parent's mobile number
- Child's medical history and vaccination records
- Lab reports

3. PURPOSES OF PROCESSING
We process your personal data and your child's personal data solely for the following lawful purposes:
- To book and manage clinical appointments;
- To maintain accurate treatment and vaccination records;
- To send automated vaccination reminders and healthcare alerts to the parent's mobile number;
- To securely share medical and lab reports with the parent.

4. WITHDRAWAL OF CONSENT
You have the right to withdraw your consent at any time. You can manage your preferences, update information, or withdraw consent by navigating to **Settings** within the app or website. Alternatively, you can request assistance via the **Help** section or by contacting our Data Protection Officer. Withdrawal of consent will not affect the lawfulness of processing based on consent before its withdrawal. Please note that withdrawing consent for essential medical and vaccination records may impact our ability to provide ongoing clinical services.

5. YOUR RIGHTS UNDER THE DPDP ACT, 2023
As a Data Principal, you have the right to:
- **Access Information:** Request a summary of the personal data we hold and the processing activities.
- **Correction and Erasure:** Request the correction of inaccurate or misleading personal data, the completion of incomplete data, or the erasure of personal data that is no longer necessary for the specified purposes.
- **Grievance Redressal:** Have your complaints and queries addressed by our Data Protection Officer in a timely manner.
- **Nomination:** Nominate another individual to exercise your rights in the event of your death or incapacity.

You can easily manage your account settings, data preferences, and exercise these rights directly under **Settings** and **Help** on our Platform.

6. DATA PROTECTION OFFICER & GRIEVANCE REDRESSAL
If you have any questions, concerns, or grievances regarding this Privacy Notice or the handling of your personal data, you may contact our Data Protection Officer (DPO):

- **Name:** Dr. Farah Ali
- **Designation:** Data Protection Officer
- **Email:** dpo@swasthyakids.in
- **Address:** Swasthya Kids Clinic, Delhi, India

We will acknowledge and respond to any complaints or grievances within **30 days** of receipt. If you are not satisfied with our response, you have the right to approach the Data Protection Board of India (DPBI).

***

**CONSENT DECLARATION:**
By clicking "Sign Up", "I Agree", or giving consent on the Platform, you acknowledge that you have read and understood this Privacy Notice, and you explicitly consent to the collection, use, and processing of your personal data and your child's personal data by Swasthya Kids Clinic for the specified purposes in accordance with the DPDP Act, 2023.
